tool.title: GitHub (issues, Actions, pull requests)
tool.description: GitHub as a Tool: the forge that carries an adjudication as an issue, runs the workflow that records it on Actions, and holds the record as a pull request for a maintainer to merge. One forge among possible others; the process names the skill, never GitHub.

install.cli: gh (optional; the web interface needs nothing)

inputs.name: repo
inputs.description: The repository holding the catalogues. Default: the current one.

outputs.name: url
outputs.description: The issue, workflow run or pull request.

selection.when: The layer's repository is on GitHub: the review page files issues there, and its caller workflow runs on Actions.
selection.limits: GitHub only. Identity is GitHub's `author_association`, so a reviewer must be an owner, member or collaborator of the repository. A PR opened with the workflow's token starts no other workflows. Another forge carrying the same `translation-adjudication/v1` record would be another Tool satisfying `translation-adjudication`.
selection.cost: Free for a public repository: issues, pull requests and the Actions minutes of one short job per adjudication.

remedies.none: The issue, the workflow and the pull request all live on GitHub; there is no offline arm. Record the verdict in the session and file it once GitHub can be reached.

$comment.comment: Owner, 2026-11-14: "GitHub is a tool." The adjudication process names its steps by skill; this node is the GitHub half of three of them (filing the issue, running the workflow, holding the PR).
